Cozy meal for the whole family
Sep 2026 • Family
My family traveled from Hanoi to Saigon for a trip, and since we were a large group, we stopped by a restaurant and tried many dishes on the menu. The food is generally well-seasoned, and the salted coffee is the favorite dish of the whole family; it is creamy but not too strong. The chef even came to the table to ask if the food suited the taste, I find that quite thoughtful. The downside is that the restaurant area is a bit small; our family of 6 sat quite close together, which was a bit inconvenient. If you go in a small group, it will probably be more comfortable.
